---
title: "How Habbo Hotel's teenage players turned to financial crime"
---

![](https://images.are.)

Habbo Hotel is an online multiplayer game aimed primarily at teenagers. The game allows you to explore rooms, chat with other players, and make your own creations. But most importantly, it allows you to trade. As Habbo's monetisation model relies on the purchase of virtual coins, it is in Habbo's interest to generate demand for their currency.
